```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

```{r siab-load-data}
mv_siab_org <- load_multiverse("siab_jan")
mv_siab_org
```

## Remove Single-Option Decisions

There are a handful of decisions with only a single option, let's drop these to not throw off any of the algorithms.

```{r siab-single-option-decisions}
mv_siab_org |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```


```{r siab-remove-fake-decisions}
mv_siab <- mv_siab_org |> 
  remove_fake_decisions()
mv_siab
```

# Overview

```{r siab-decisions-overview}
mv_siab |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r siab-multiverse-simple-down}
#| fig-height: 10
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_siab, direction = "down")
```


```{r siab-multiverse-simple-right}

#| fig-height: 4
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_siab, direction = "right", decision_label_pos = 0, decision_label_angle = -7, option_label_offset_x = 0.1)
```

```{r siab-performance-hist}
mv_siab |> 
  ggplot() +
```

# Existing Methods

## Regression

```{r siab-regression-fit}
reg_siab <- calc_regression(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc")
attr(reg_siab, "tidy")
```

## FANOVA

```{r siab-fanova-fit}
fanova_siab <- calc_fanova(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc")
fanova_siab
```

```{r siab-fanova-importance-plot}
fanova_siab |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```

Only main effects

```{r siab-fanova-main-effects-plot}
fanova_siab |>
  filter(is.na(level_1)) |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```

# Our Framework

```{r siab-decide}
decide_siab <- decide(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc")
decide_siab
```

```{r siab-decide-plot}
decide_vec(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc") |>
  vis_importance()
```

## Combine

```{r siab-combine-importance}
vis_importance_2dim(
  decide_vec(mv_siab, colname_metric = "perf_acc"),
  fanova_siab |> fanova_to_vec()
)
```

# Ablation Study

Fix each decision to one option, recompute the importance estimates on the
reduced multiverse, and compare the resulting importance vectors across
methods and across options of the fixed decision.

```{r siab-ablation-run}
ablation_siab <- run_ablation_analysis(
  mv_siab,
  colname_metric = "perf_acc"
)
```

## Inter-method stability

The table below shows the baseline agreement between methods on the full
multiverse, plus the average agreement after fixing each decision and averaging
over that decision's options.

```{r siab-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_siab$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r siab-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
vis_inter_method_stability(ablation_siab$inter_method_stability_summary) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Intra-method stability

For each method separately, compare its full-multiverse importance vector to
the importance vector obtained after fixing one decision to one option, then
average those correlations over the options of the fixed decision.

```{r siab-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_siab$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r siab-ablation-intra-method-plot}
vis_intra_method_stability(ablation_siab$intra_method_stability_summary)
```
